name: auto-height
title: Auto Height
description: A bordered card holding a short release note. Clicking Show more swaps in a longer three-paragraph version while the card springs to the new height and the text crossfades.
use: Text of unknown length must swap without the surrounding layout jumping or leaving a gap.
avoid: It measures children on each dependency change, so very tall or frequently changing content can cause visible reflow.
a11y: It honours reduced motion by snapping the height, but the wrapper adds no roles or live announcement, so a content swap can go unnoticed. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark rounded card with a thin border holding a paragraph of small grey text and a compact outlined Show more button below. Expanded, the same card grows taller to fit three paragraphs.
behaves: Clicking the button swaps the paragraph for a three-paragraph version; the card's height springs to fit while the old text blurs out and the new text blurs in. Clicking again returns to the short version.
customise: Children are the content; deps decide when to re-measure, and the animate and transition props override the spring. The Show more button and copy live in the demo.
weight: light: One ResizeObserver and a single height spring; nothing runs between content changes.
demo: A release note about version 4.2 adding offline mode, a faster editor and improved sharing.
issues: The button label swaps ahead of the height, so a tall card briefly sits behind Show more.
polishWhy: Clean, focused demo of a height spring; the button label briefly mismatches the expanded card.
